title: Export Readiness Diagnostics — Final Evidence Report

findings.title: firebase_token localStorage key never set
findings.description: The frontend reads localStorage.getItem('firebase_token') but this key is never written anywhere in the codebase. Result: all API calls using this pattern send empty Bearer token, causing 401.
findings.verificationResult: NO MATCHES - key is never set
findings.recommendedFix: Replace localStorage.getItem('firebase_token') with getAuthHeaders() from packages/web/src/lib/authHeaders.ts which uses getAuth().currentUser.getIdToken(true)

findings.title: Dual export readiness panels in Product Editor
findings.description: ProductEditorPage renders both CompletionExportGatePanel (new) and ExportReadinessPanel (legacy), potentially showing conflicting information.
findings.recommendedFix: Remove ExportReadinessPanel from ProductEditorPage.tsx or conditionally render only if CompletionExportGatePanel fails

findings.title: Clear three-layer completion architecture
findings.description: Completion evaluation has well-structured layers: completionRulesService (settings), exportService (attributes), completionEvaluationEngine (pure logic). Settings at settings/exportSettings.completionRules, attributes at settings/attributes/keys/*
findings.recommendedFix: No fix needed - architecture is sound

findings.title: SDK vs Firestore attribute count mismatch (69 vs 119)
findings.description: SDK attributeRegistry.json has 69 attributes while Firestore settings/attributes/keys has 119. The loadExportableAttributes() function filters using SDK isExportable() check, silently excluding 50 Firestore-only attributes.
findings.recommendedFix: Audit the 50 Firestore-only attributes. Either sync to SDK or implement warning logging when SDK filter excludes attributes.

findings.title: export field schema mismatch (boolean vs object)
findings.description: Attribute updates fail with 400 because Firestore has 'export: true' (boolean) but SDK AttributeSchema expects 'export: { key?, omitIfEmpty?, targets? }' (object). Any PATCH triggers full revalidation which fails on legacy boolean.
findings.recommendedFix: Option A: Update schema to z.union([z.boolean(), ExportMetadataSchema]). Option B: Normalize boolean to undefined in fromFirestore(). Option C: Run migration to convert all boolean exports to objects.

commandsExecuted.result: 200 OK with readiness JSON (7 products ready)
settings/attributes/keys: 119 docs, settings/exportSettings: exists with completionRules
400 validation_failed - export: Expected object, received boolean

implementationRequired.title: Fix firebase_token localStorage bug
implementationRequired.description: Replace localStorage.getItem('firebase_token') with getAuthHeaders() or inline getAuth().currentUser?.getIdToken(true)

implementationRequired.title: Fix export field schema mismatch
implementationRequired.description: Change export field to z.union([z.boolean(), ExportMetadataSchema]).optional()

implementationRequired.title: Sync SDK registry with Firestore
implementationRequired.description: Audit and document 50 missing attributes, add to SDK or add warning log

conclusion: Diagnostic investigation complete. Two critical bugs identified (firebase_token never set, export schema mismatch) with clear root causes and recommended fixes. No production writes or registry changes were made. Awaiting approval to proceed with implementation LP.
